title: Invoices save no hidden type; installments come only from the CRM's amounts
text: The New Invoice window no longer has a Payment Type. A one-off invoice now saves exactly what you see: the service, the lines and the amount, with no hidden type and no hidden year. A yearly installment can only be made from the Annual Installments box on the company page: it is filled in from the company's installment amount in the CRM, and its type and year are locked. Invoices made from a bank payment no longer get a fixed "One-Time Service" label, and automatic card payment now includes every invoice type except credit notes.
points: Finance → New Invoice: no Payment Type any more
Company page → Annual Installments → Invoice: the type and the year are shown and locked
If an invoice already exists for that installment and year, you are told so instead of getting a second one
An installment that was cancelled can be invoiced again; one fully covered by the client's credit starts its yearly steps right away
The contract signing and the yearly run create installments exactly as before
